category_title: Impulsive male students prone to rule-breaking and interruptions
scenario_title: Emotional outbursts and defensiveness during peer disagreement
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a circle with peers in a locked classroom, practicing how to agree or disagree with previous speakers during a discussion.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that we are sitting in our circle, let's continue the discussion. Remember to state whether you agree or disagree with the previous speaker's point.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why did he just disagree with my idea? I'm not wrong. He's just saying that to make me look stupid.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: He is just sharing his perspective. What do you think about what he said?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I think it's unfair criticism! He's always trying to attack me and say my viewpoints are wrong.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's try to keep going. Can you respond to his point?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and starts shouting at the peer) Shut up! You don't know anything! If you say I'm wrong one more time, you're going to regret it!

TUTOR: Now that we are sitting in our circle, let's continue the discussion. Remember to state whether you agree or disagree with the previous speaker's point.

TUTOR: He is just sharing his perspective. What do you think about what he said?

STUDENT: I think it's unfair criticism! He's always trying to attack me and say my viewpoints are wrong.

TUTOR: Let's try to keep going. Can you respond to his point?

STUDENT: (Stands up and starts shouting at the peer) Shut up! You don't know anything! If you say I'm wrong one more time, you're going to regret it!

task.content: Agree/disagree with at least one previous speaker and give reasons for their agreement/disagreement using the format: 'I agree with [person's name] because...'

context.social_setting: Participants sit in a circle in order to see one another

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When another participant disagreed with them
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Interpreted as their viewpoint being seen as wrong or subject to unfair criticism

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Emotional outbursts, shouting for several brief periods, and a degree of intimidation by one child towards another child
